description: This file defines the ProviderRole class, which represents roles that providers can have within the OpenMRS system. It includes annotations for persistence, inheritance strategy, and auditing, along with methods for accessing and modifying the provider role ID. The class extends BaseOpenmrsMetadata, inheriting name and other metadata attributes.

classes.name: ProviderRole
classes.description: Represents a role that a provider can have, used to categorize or assign specific permissions or responsibilities within the healthcare system.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the provider role ID, inherited from BaseOpenmrsMetadata.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the provider role ID, inherited from BaseOpenmrsMetadata.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ProviderRole object, including its ID and name.
